tickets.title: US001 - Verified University Account
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to verify my university email account, so that only eligible campus users can access the marketplace.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if a new account requires an approved .edu domain and verification token.
- PASS if an unverified user cannot create listings, bid, or chat.
- PASS if verification expiry or revocation blocks marketplace actions.
- FAIL if a non-approved email can use marketplace features.

tickets.title: US002 - Barcode-Assisted Listing
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to scan an item barcode while creating a listing, so that book and calculator details can be entered quickly and accurately.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if scanning a recognized barcode fills item title and category.
- PASS if the seller can edit scanned details before publishing.
- PASS if an unknown barcode falls back to manual entry.
- FAIL if a listing publishes without required title, category, and condition.

tickets.title: US003 - Fixed-Price Or Auction Listing
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want to list an item for a fixed price or approved auction, so that I can sell campus items using the format that fits the item.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if the seller must choose fixed price or auction before publishing.
- PASS if auction listings require end time, opening bid, and bid increment.
- PASS if the app clearly says payment is arranged outside the app.
- FAIL if the app processes, collects, or calculates a payment fee.

tickets.title: US004 - Safe-Zone-Gated Chat
tickets.description:
As a Student, I want chat to open only after a safe exchange zone is selected, so that buyer and seller communication supports safer campus meetups.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if buyer/seller chat is locked until an approved safe zone is chosen.
- PASS if the selected zone is visible to both participants in the conversation.
- PASS if changing the zone updates the meeting record.
- FAIL if chat can start with no approved exchange location.

tickets.title: US005 - Safe Exchange Zone Admin
tickets.description:
As an Administrator, I want to manage approved safe exchange zones, so that students can select only vetted campus meetup locations.

Acceptance Criteria:
- PASS if an admin can add, edit, deactivate, and view safe zones.
- PASS if inactive zones cannot be selected for new meetings.
- PASS if existing meetings keep a historical record of the zone used.
- FAIL if a student can create a custom unapproved exchange zone.

tickets.description: Privacy and Compliance: the marketplace must not collect card numbers, bank credentials, or in-app payment details, and buyer/seller contact information must be visible only to authenticated participants in that transaction.

analysis.ambiguity1: Stakeholder requirement: the legal team wants only students with a valid .edu email account to use the marketplace. This is ambiguous because it does not define which domains qualify, whether subdomains are accepted, how email ownership is verified, whether alumni accounts remain valid, or how often accounts must be revalidated. Developers need allowed institutions/domains, verification flow, token expiry, account lifecycle rules, and recheck frequency.
analysis.ambiguity2: Stakeholder requirement: the Student Union wants students to sell books, calculators, and 'auction items.' This is ambiguous because auction rules are not defined: bid increments, start/end times, reserve prices, tie handling, cancellation rules, prohibited goods, and nonpayment handling are all unspecified. Developers need the permitted item categories, listing lifecycle, bidding rules, winner selection, and dispute policy before building auction behavior.
analysis.conflictSolution: Conflict: the legal team says the marketplace must not process payments, while the Student Union wants to charge a 2% transaction fee to fund activities. Resolution: keep payments completely outside the app and do not collect, transmit, calculate, or escrow money. The app can support listings, safe-zone selection, and buyer/seller messaging, while funding comes from an optional club donation, sponsor placement, or approved flat listing/membership fee that is not tied to sale amount. Legal review must approve any fee copy before release.
